name: Ollama v0.40.18 runs Inkling 2 Mini on Windows and Linux and adds custom Mac kernels
title: Ollama v0.40.18 runs Inkling 2 Mini on Windows and Linux and adds custom Mac kernels
headline: Ollama v0.40.18 runs Inkling 2 Mini across desktop OSes
lede: Developers can run Thinking Machines' 26B (5.4B active) Inkling 2 Mini locally in Ollama v0.40.18 on 32 GB Windows and Linux machines, with custom Mac kernels and Fireworks hosting for Small and Mini.

effects.effect: Pairs local Ollama serving with hosted Fireworks endpoints for Inkling 2 models.
Makes 26B sparse models runnable on 32 GB Windows, Linux, and Mac machines.
